comparison.objective: Transfer a loaded tray and two tins to a shelf before withdrawing support.
comparison.physical_skill: Load-preserving tray transport and hand withdrawal, not tool insertion, threaded locking, or iterative damping adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Tray and tins must remain together; exact containment and placement tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests supported transport rather than shock-absorber commissioning.
